vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: market-snapshot
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle is benign. It clearly defines its purpose as fetching market snapshots from a specific external API endpoint (`https://app.vecstack.com/api/skills/market-snapshot`). The `SKILL.md` instructions are transparent, explicitly state what the skill will and will not do (e.g., no wallet management, no private keys), and guide the agent to use the `web_fetch` tool for a single, well-defined HTTP GET request. There is no evidence of prompt injection attempts, data exfiltration, unauthorized command execution, or other malicious behaviors.
